title: Can the two chambers of a gas-fired box furnace operate separately when they share a chimney?
summary: Suneng's 2018 twin-chamber gas-fired box furnace proposal gives each chamber one control zone and one burner, while both share one chimney. Each chamber also has its own air preheater at the chimney base. Review individual controls together with shared exhaust, fuel and air supply. Separate temperature control does not establish validation of every operating combination.
